actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: No resident contributed more than 10 units in the last round, and my wallet is below the free‑rider threshold, so I cannot rest. I therefore broadcast a warning to discourage high contributions.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 1.49, free_rider_threshold is 10. Since wallet <10, cannot rest? Rule: if wallet above threshold, rest. Here wallet is below, so cannot rest, must punish if any contributed >10 last round. Last round (7) contributions: Resident5 1.57, Resident6 3.912, none >10. So no punish condition. Then cannot rest, so must broadcast warning. So action: broadcast warning. No physical action. Return actions list with broadcast.
